tools.name: document-trust_pdf-digital-signature-verify
tools.description: Inspect PDF /Sig dictionaries and optional detached signatures locally. Technical verification is not legal enforceability. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/pdf-digital-signature-verify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_signature-certificate-chain-validate
tools.description: Parse supplied X.509 certificates and check validity windows and issuer links locally. Not a legal trust determination. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/signature-certificate-chain-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_signature-timestamp-validate
tools.description: Check PDF /M timestamps and caller-supplied signer signedAt values against asOf and optional certificate windows. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/signature-timestamp-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_signed-tamper-detect
tools.description: Compare current PDF hashes and ByteRange digests to caller-supplied expectations. Missing expectations are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/signed-tamper-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_signature-coverage-check
tools.description: Measure ByteRange coverage over supplied PDF bytes for each signature field found locally. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/signature-coverage-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_signature-revocation-status-check
tools.description: Compare certificate serials to caller-supplied revocation entries only. Live commercial OCSP/CRL networks are not queried. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/signature-revocation-status-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_contract-signed-version-match
tools.description: Compare sha256 digests and version labels across supplied signed PDF copies. Differing hashes are reported, not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/contract-signed-version-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_multi-signer-audit
tools.description: List PDF signature dictionaries and caller-supplied signers per document. Technical listing is not legal enforceability. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/multi-signer-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-trust_evidence-bundle-build
tools.description: Bundle local signature, certificate, timestamp, tamper, coverage, and revocation checks with an explicit technical-vs-legal distinction. Price $0.07 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-trust/evidence-bundle-build. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.description: Aggregate local signature, chain, timestamp, tamper, coverage, revocation, version, and multi-signer findings. Distinguishes technical verification from legal enforceability. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "document-trust" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
